title: 5AM - 7AM PROPHETIC MORNING DECLARATIONS
text: Beloved, before we go into the deep things of the spirit this morning, I want you to do something for me. I want you to share this prayer point. I want you to send it to somebody. There is someone on your contact list. There is someone in your family. There is someone in your circle of influence that needs to hear what the spirit of God is about to release right now. Don't just keep it to yourself. The Bible says in Ecclesiastes chapter 4 that two are better than one and a three-fold cord is not quickly broken. When you share this, you are creating an atmosphere of corporate intercession. You are building a wall of fire around your generation. So right now, pause and send this to at least three people. Send it to that brother. Send it to that sister. Send it to that family member who needs a touch from heaven. This is not ordinary what God is about to do in this moment will shake the foundations of darkness assigned against your life. Now I want you to understand something this morning. The hour between 5 and 7 in the morning is not accidental. It is strategic. It is prophetic. When Jesus walked the earth, the Bible says in Mark 1:35, and in the morning rising up a great while before day, he went out and departed into a solitary place and there prayed. This was not a religious routine. This was a divine pattern. There is something about the morning hours that carries the freshness of God's mercies. Lamentations 3:23 says, "They are new every morning. Great is thy faithfulness. Every morning heaven opens a fresh page. Every morning there is a new download of grace. Every morning there is a reset button that God wants to push in your life. But you see the enemy also knows this. The powers of darkness understand the strategic importance of the morning hours. That is why they assign spirits to attack your mind early in the morning with depression, with fear, with anxiety, with discouragement. Have you ever noticed that some of your worst thoughts come in the morning? Have you ever noticed that between the hours of 3 and 6 a.m. your mind can be bombarded with negativity? This is not coincidental. It is a calculated attack. But I have come to announce to you this morning that we are taking back that time. We are sanctifying those hours. We are converting what the enemy meant for evil into a launching path for divine encounters. The Bible says in Psalm 63:1, "Oh God, thou art my God. Early will I seek thee. My soul thirsteth for thee. My flesh longeth for thee in a dry and thirsty land where no water is. David understood something. He understood that seeking God early was not just about discipline. It was about desperation. It was about positioning. When you seek God in the morning, you are setting the spiritual temperature for the entire day. You are establishing the frequency upon which your life will operate. You are tuning your spirit to the broadcast of heaven. So right now, I want you to lift up your voice. I don't care where you are. I don't care who is around you. I want you to open your mouth and begin to decree. Say, "Father, I thank you for the breath of life. I thank you that I am alive to see this morning. I thank you that while others did not make it through the night, your mercy kept me. I sanctify this day. I consecrate these hours. I dedicate this morning to your glory. Let your presence saturate every moment. Let your wisdom guide every decision. Let your power enforce every word that comes out of my mouth in the name of Jesus. Now, I need you to understand the power of prophetic declarations. The Bible says in Proverbs 18:21, "Death and life are in the power of the tongue, and they that love it shall eat the food thereof." Your mouth is not just for eating. Your mouth is a weapon. Your tongue is a rudder that steers the ship of your destiny. James chapter 3 tells us that though the tongue is a small member, it boasts of great things. A small fire can set ablaze a great forest. What you say in the morning determines what manifest in your day. What you decree in the secret place [music] becomes established in the public square. The Bible says in Job 22:28, "Thou shalt also decree a thing, and it shall be established unto thee, and the light shall shine upon thy ways." I want you to [music] decree right now. Say, I decree that every plan of the enemy against my life is aborted. I decree that every weapon fashioned against me shall not prosper. I decree that every tongue that rises against me in judgment, I shall condemn. This is my heritage as a servant of the Lord. My righteousness is of the Lord. I decree that I am the head and not the tail. I am above only and not beneath. I am blessed coming in and blessed going out. I decree that goodness and mercy are following me all the days of my life. I decree that I dwell in the secret place of the most high and I abide under the shadow of the almighty. No evil shall befall me. No plague shall come near my dwelling. For he shall give his angels charge over me to keep me in all my ways in the name of Jesus. You see, when you make these declarations, you are not just speaking words. You are releasing the creative [music] power of God. In Genesis chapter 1, God said, "Let there be light and there was light." God did not go and create light with his hands. He spoke it into existence. You are made in the image and likeness of God. You carry that same creative ability. Your words have the power to create [music] realities. Your declarations have the power to shift atmospheres. The question is, what are you speaking? What are you decreeing? Are you agreeing with the voice of fear or the voice of faith? Are you echoing the report of the enemy or the report of the Lord? This morning, I want to address the spirit of fear that may be operating in your life. The Bible says in 2 Timothy 1:7, "For [music] God hath not given us the spirit of fear, but of power and of love and of a sound mind. Fear is not from God. Anxiety is not from God. Worry is not from God." These are weapons that the enemy uses to paralyze your faith and abort your destiny. But I have come to announce to you that perfect love casts out fear. The love of God that has been shed abroad in your heart by the Holy Spirit is greater than every spirit of fear. So right now I want you to confront that fear. I want you to address it. [music] Say, "Spirit of fear, I resist you in the name of Jesus. You have no place in my life. You have no authority over my mind. I am not your victim. I am not your slave. I am a child of the living God. I have been bought with a price. I have been redeemed by the blood of the lamb. Greater is he that is in me than he that is in the world. I decree that I have not been given a spirit of fear, but of power, of love, and of a sound mind. Therefore, I walk in boldness. I walk in confidence. I walk in divine assurance. No weapon of fear shall prosper against me in the name of Jesus. Now, I want to talk to you about the spirit of delay. There are some of you listening to me right now and you have been experiencing unprecedented delays. Things that should have happened years ago are still pending. Opportunities that should have manifested are still in the pipeline. Breakthroughs that should have come have been stalled. I want you to know that this is not natural. This is spiritual. There are powers of delay assigned against certain bloodlines, against certain families, against certain destinies. The Bible tells us in Daniel chapter 10 that Daniel prayed and from the first day that he set his heart to understand his [music] prayer was heard. But the prince of Persia withtood the angel for 21 days. This tells us something very important. Your prayers are heard in heaven but there are territorial spirits that can delay the manifestation of your answers. There are princes of darkness that can create bottlenecks in the realm of the spirit. But I have good news for you this morning. The same God who sent the angel Michael to break through for Daniel is the same God who is available to break through for you. The Bible says in Isaiah 59:1 19, when the enemy shall come in like a flood, the spirit of the Lord shall lift up a standard against him. So I want you to pray with me right now. Say, every spirit of delay assigned against my life, I bind you in the name of Jesus. Every prince of Peshia, every territorial spirit, every principality standing between me and my breakthrough, I command you to bow in the name of Jesus. I release the angels of the Lord to go before me and make the crooked places straight. I release divine acceleration. I call forth speed in the spirit. What should have taken years shall take months. What should have taken months shall take weeks. What should have taken weeks shall take days. I decree suddenly. I decree unexpected open doors. I decree divine connections. I decree uncommon favor. Let the gates lift up their heads. Let the everlasting doors be opened that the king of glory may come in. Who is this king of glory? The Lord strong and mighty. The Lord mighty in battle. In the name of Jesus. I need to talk to you about your bloodline. There are some of you and you are the first person in your family to have an encounter with Jesus Christ. You are the first believer. You are the Joseph of your generation. And because of that, you carry a weighty assignment. You are not just saved for yourself. You are safe for your family. The Bible says in Acts 16:31, "Believe on the Lord Jesus Christ and thou shalt be saved and thy house." Your salvation carries implications for your entire household. But here is what you need to understand. When you give your life to Christ, you become a threat to the kingdom of darkness. Ancestral powers that have been operating in your family for generations suddenly realize that their stronghold has been invaded. And they will fight back. They will fight your peace. They will fight your progress. They will fight your relationships. They will fight your finances. But I have come to declare to you this morning that the battle is not yours. It is the Lord's. The Bible says in 2 Chronicles 20:15, "Be not afraid, not dismayed by reason of this great multitude. For the battle is not yours, but God's." Right now, I want you to take authority over every ancestral covenant. Say, "Every covenant that my ancestors entered into with darkness, I renounce it in the name of Jesus. Every altar speaking against my destiny, I command fire from heaven to consume it. Every satanic dedication, every evil initiation, every demonic mark placed upon my life, I erase it by the blood of Jesus, I am a new creation in Christ Jesus. Old things have passed away. Behold, all things have [music] become new. I am no longer identified by my past. I am no longer defined by my family history. I am defined by the blood of Jesus. I am identified by the cross. I decree that as for me and my house, we shall serve the Lord in the name of Jesus. There is something I want you to understand about the blood of Jesus. The blood is not just a theological concept. It is a spiritual weapon. When Moses was in Egypt and God was about to release the final plague, he instructed the Israelites to take the blood of a lamb and apply it to the doorposts of their houses. When the death angel saw the blood, he passed over. The blood was a sign of protection. The blood was a sign of covenant. The blood was a sign of redemption. Today, we have access to something greater than the blood of lambs and goats. We have access to the blood of Jesus Christ, the lamb of God who takes away the sin of the world. Hebrews 12:4 says that the blood of Jesus speaks better things than the blood of Abel. Abel's blood cried out for vengeance. But Jesus's blood cries out for mercy. It cries out for forgiveness. It cries out for redemption. It cries out for restoration. So right now, I want you to plead the blood. Say, I plead the blood of Jesus over my life. I plead the blood of Jesus over my family. I plead the blood of Jesus over my finances. I plead the blood of Jesus over my health. I plead the blood of Jesus over my mind. I cover myself with the blood. I cover my children with the blood. I cover my spouse with the blood. I cover my business with the blood. Let the blood speak on my behalf. Let the blood silence every accusation. Let the blood cancel every debt. Let the blood break every curse. Let the blood reverse every evil verdict. By the blood of Jesus, I am redeemed from the curse of the law. By the blood of Jesus, I am justified. By the blood of Jesus, [music] I am sanctified. By the blood of Jesus, I overcome in the name of Jesus. Now, I want to shift into the area of your thoughts. The Bible says in 2 Corinthians 10:5, "Casting down imaginations and every high thing that exaltth itself against the knowledge of God, and bringing into captivity every thought to the obedience of Christ." Your thought life is a battlefield. The enemy knows that if he can control your thoughts, he can control your life. That is why he bombards your mind with negative thoughts, with lustful thoughts, with fearful thoughts, with doubtful thoughts. But you are not a victim of your thoughts. You have the power to cast them down. You have the authority to reject them. You have the ability to replace them with the word of God. The Bible says in Philippians 4:8, "Finally, brethren, whatsoever things are true, whatsoever things are honest, whatsoever things are just, whatsoever things are pure, whatsoever things are lovely, whatsoever things are of good report, if there be any virtue, and if there be any praise, think on these things." Right now, I want you to take authority over your mind. Say, I cast down every imagination that exalts [music] itself against the knowledge of God. I bring into captivity every thought to the obedience of Christ. I refuse to entertain thoughts of fear. I refuse to entertain thoughts of doubt. I refuse to entertain thoughts of perversion. I refuse to entertain thoughts of failure. I choose to think on things that are true, things that are honest, things that are just, things that are pure, things that are lovely, things that are of good report. I have the mind of Christ. My mind is renewed by the word of God. My thoughts are aligning with heaven in the name of Jesus. I want to talk to you about your gates. In the spiritual realm, gates represent access points. [music] They represent entry points. The Bible talks about the gates of righteousness, the gates of praise, the gates of thanksgiving. But there are also negative gates. Gates that the enemy uses to gain access into your life. These gates can be opened through sin, through trauma, through curses, through covenants, through disobedience. When a gate is open to the enemy, he establishes a legal right to operate in that area of your life. That is why you can pray and fast, but certain things don't change. It is not because God is not powerful. It is because there is a gate that needs to be closed. There is a legal ground that needs to be revoked. The Bible says in Ephesians 4:27, "Neither give place to the devil." The word place, there's the Greek word topos, which means territory or ground. Right now, I want you to close every gate. Say, every gate I open to the enemy through sin, I close it by the blood of Jesus. Every gate opened through unforgiveness, I close it right now. Every gate opened through bitterness, through anger, through lust, through pride, through rebellion, I shut it in the name of Jesus. [music] I revoke every legal ground. I cancel every access point. I deny the enemy entering into my life, into my family, into my destiny. I open the gates of righteousness. I open the gates of praise. I open the gates of worship. Lift up your heads, oh ye gates. Even lift them up, ye everlasting doors, and the king of glory shall come in in the name of Jesus. There is a dimension of prayer that many believers have not accessed, and it is the place of travail. The Bible talks about this in Romans 8:26. [music] Likewise, the Spirit also helpeth our infirmities. For we know not what we should pray for as we ought, but the Spirit itself maketh intercession for us with groanings [music] which cannot be uttered. There is a kind of prayer that goes beyond words. It is a prayer of groaning. It is a prayer of travail. It is a prayer that gives birth to breakthroughs. When a woman is in labor, she groans. She travails. She pushes and eventually she gives birth. In the same way, there are spiritual realities that require travailing prayer. There are breakthroughs that will not come through casual prayer. They require intensity. They require ferveny. They require persistence. The Bible says in James 5:16, "The effectual fervent prayer of a righteous man availth much." So right now, I am asking you to travail. I am asking you to groan in the spirit. I am asking you to push. Let the Holy Spirit pray through you. Let the Holy Spirit birth something new in your life. Don't be afraid to cry. Don't be afraid to grow. Don't be ashamed of your desperation. God honors desperation. God honors hunger. God honors those who press in with everything they have. Say this with me. Holy Spirit, I yield to you. Pray through me. Grown through me. birth through me. I am desperate for a move of God. I am hungry for a breakthrough. I refuse to settle for mediocrity. I refuse to accept the status quo. I press in. I push forward. I contend for the promises. I wrestle with heaven until my breakthrough manifest. Like Jacob, I declare I will not let you go until you [music] bless me. Lord, touch my life. Transform my situation. turn my captivity in the name of Jesus. I need to address the spirit of stagnation. There are some of you and you have been in the same place spiritually, financially, relationally for [music] too long. You are not moving forward. You are not moving backward. You are just stuck. This is the work of the spirit of stagnation. It is a spirit that keeps you cycling the same mountain. It is a spirit that keeps you repeating the same cycles. It is a spirit that makes you busy but not productive, active but not progressive. But I hear the word of the Lord for you this morning. The Bible says in Deuteronomy 2:3, "Ye have compass this mountain long enough. Turn you northward." God is saying enough is enough. It is time to move forward. It is time to advance. It is time to possess your possession. The same God who brought the children of Israel out of the wilderness is able to bring you out. The same God who led them into the promised land is able to lead you into your season of fulfillment. Pray this with me. Spirit of stagnation, I bind you in the name of Jesus. Spirit of limitation, I reject you. Spirit of frustration, I rebuke you. I decree movement. I decree advancement. I decree elevation. I decree acceleration. I shall not die in the wilderness. I shall not circle the same mountain forever. I am breaking out. I am breaking forth. I am breaking through. My time has come. My season has arrived. My moment is now. I move from glory to glory, from strength to strength, from level to level, from dimension to dimension in the name of Jesus. Let me talk to you about divine alignment. There are people God has assigned to connect with you. There are doors God has ordained to open for you. There are opportunities God has prepared for you. But if you are out of alignment, you will miss them. Alignment is about being in the right place at the right time with the right people doing the right thing. When you are in alignment, things flow. When you are out of alignment, everything is [music] a struggle. The Bible says in Psalm 1:1, "Blessed is the man that walketh not in the counsel of the ungodly, nor standeth in the way of sinners, nor sitth in the seat [music] of the scornful. Your associations determine your altitude. Your company determines your character. Your network determines your net worth. You cannot hang around eagles and expect to fly with chickens. You cannot fellowship with darkness and walk [music] in the light. Right now, I want you to pray for divine alignment. Say, "Father, align me with my destiny. Connect me with the right people. Open the right doors. Close the wrong doors. Disconnect me from every wrong association. Separate me from every relationship that is draining my anointing. Lead me to those you have assigned to me. Lead me to my divine helpers. Lead me to my covenant connections. Let me be in the right place at the right time. Let me walk in divine alignment in the name of Jesus. I want to prophesy over your finances. The Bible says in Philippians 4:1 19, "But my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus." Notice it does not say according to your bank account. It does not say according to the economy. It does not say according to your salary. It says according to his riches in glory. God's economy does not crash. God's resources do not diminish. God's supply does not run out. There are some of you who have been struggling financially. And I want you to know that it is not the will of God for you to barely survive. Yes, the Bible talks about contentment, but it also talks about abundance. Jesus said in John 10:10, "I am come that they might have life and that they might have it more abundantly." God wants you to have enough for yourself and enough to bless others. But here is the key. You must position yourself for financial blessings. You must honor God with your finances. You must be a giver. The Bible says in Luke 6:38, "Give and it shall be given unto you good measure pressed down and shaken together and running over shall men give into your bosom. For with the same measure that ye met me with al, it shall be measured to you again. You cannot outgive God. When you give, you activate the principle of sewing and reaping. When you give, you open the windows of heaven. When you give, you position yourself for supernatural provision. Declare this. I am blessed financially. I am blessed spiritually. I am blessed in every area of my life. The Lord is my shepherd. I shall not want. He makes me to lie down in green pastures. He leads me beside the still waters. He restores my soul. My cup runs over. I walk in divine provision. I walk in supernatural abundance. The windows of heaven are open over my life. The divor is rebuked for my sake. My bands are filled with plenty. My vats overflow with new wine. I am the lender and not the borrower. Wealth and riches are in my house. The blessing of the Lord makes me rich and adds no sorrow with it in the name of Jesus. Now I want to pray for your health. The Bible says in 3R John verse 2, "Beloved, I wish above all things that thou mayest prosper and be in health, even as thy soul prosperth." God cares about your health. God cares about your body. Your body is the temple of the Holy Spirit. You cannot fulfill your assignment if you are constantly sick. You cannot walk in your purpose if you are battling infirmity. There are some of you dealing with chronic conditions, with unexplainable sicknesses, with stubborn ailments. I want you to know that Jesus is still the healer. The Bible says in 1 Peter 2:4, "Who his own self bear our sins in his own body on the tree, that we being dead to sin should live unto righteousness, by whose stripes ye were healed." Notice it does not say you will be healed. It says you were healed. Your healing is not a future promise. It is a finished work. It was accomplished at the cross. So right now I want you to receive your healing. Say by the stripes of Jesus I am healed. Every infirmity I command you to leave my body. Every sickness, every disease, every affliction, I rebuke you in the name of Jesus. I speak to my body. I command alignment. I command restoration. I command wholeness. From the crown of my head to the soles of my feet, I am healed. My immune system is strong. My organs function properly. My blood flows correctly. My bones are [music] strong. My mind is sound. I walk in divine health. I walk in supernatural strength. I am healed in the name of Jesus. Let me address those who are believing God for the fruit of the womb. I know the pain of waiting. I know the frustration of seeing others with what you are praying for. I know the disappointment of negative reports. But I want to remind you of Hannah. The Bible says in 1st Samuel 1 that Hannah was barren and her rival provoked her saw but Hannah did not give up. Hannah did not accept the verdict. Hannah went to the house of God and she poured out her soul before the Lord. She travailed. She wept. She made a vow and God heard her. God remembered her. God opened her womb. The same God who opened Hannah's womb is able to open yours. The same God who gave Sarah a child in her old age is able to give you a child. The same God who gave Rael and Rebecca children after years of waiting is able to give you a child. The Bible says in Psalm 113:9, he maketh the barren woman to keep house and to be a joyful mother of children. Praise ye the Lord. Pray with me. Father, I thank you that you are the giver of life. I thank you that children are inherited from the Lord and the fruit of the womb is your reward. I speak to my womb. I command it to be fruitful. I cancel every verdict of barness. I break every [music] cause of fruitlessness. I reject every report of impossibility. With God, all things are possible. What is impossible with men is possible with God. I receive my miracle. I receive my seed. I receive my child. My womb is blessed. My body is blessed. My marriage is blessed. I shall be a joyful mother of children in the name of Jesus. I want to talk to you about divine speed. There is a dimension where God accelerates processes. There is a dimension where things that should have taken years happen in months. The Bible says in Isaiah 60:22, "A little one shall become a thousand and a small one a strong nation. I the Lord will hasten it in his time." God has the ability to hasten things. God has the ability to fast forward processes. Look at the life of Joseph. He went from the prison to the palace in one day. One prophetic dream, one divine interpretation and his entire life changed. Look at the children of Israel in Egypt. They were slaves for 430 years. But when God moved, they were out in one night. Look at the early church on the day of Pentecost. 120 people in the upper room. And by the end of the day, 3,000 were added. That is divine speed. God is about to accelerate things in your life. Things that have been delayed are about to manifest suddenly. Opportunities that you thought were gone are about to resurface unexpectedly. Doors that were closed are about to swing open supernaturally. Get ready for divine speed. Get ready for acceleration. Get ready for suddenly. Decree this. I call forth divine speed in my life. What the enemy delayed for years, I command it [music] to manifest now. What the devil stole, I command restoration. What was lost, I command recovery. I decree suddenly, I decree open doors. I decree uncommon favor. I decree supernatural connections. I decree divine opportunities. My time is now. My season is now. My breakthrough is now. In the name of Jesus, as we come toward the close of this time of prayer and declaration, I want you to understand that what we have done here is not ordinary. We have not just said words. We have released decrees that have gone into the courts of heaven. We have made declarations that have shifted things in the realm of the spirit. We have prayed prayers that have moved the hand of God. The Bible says in Matthew 18:18, "Verily I say unto you, whatsoever ye shall bind on earth shall be bound in heaven, [music] and whatsoever ye shall loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven. Everything you have bound this morning is bound. Everything you have loosed is loosed. Every word you have spoken in faith shall come to pass. Every decree you have made shall be established. You are not going to leave this place the same way you came. You are not going to end this day the way you started it. Something has shifted. Something has changed. Something has broken. Can you sense it in your spirit? Can you feel the heaviness lifting? Can you perceive the atmosphere changing? Now, I want you to do something very important. I want you to thank God in advance. I want you to worship him for what he's about to do. The Bible says in Psalm 100:4, "Enter into his gates with thanksgiving and into his courts with praise. Be thankful unto him and bless his name. Thanksgiving is a weapon. Praise is a weapon. When you thank God before you see the manifestation, you are operating in faith. When you worship him in advance, you are demonstrating confidence in his ability. So, lift up your voice right now. Say, "Father, I thank you. I thank you for what you are doing. I thank you for what you are about to do. I thank you for the breakthrough that is coming. I thank you for the doors that are opening. I thank you for the favor that is flowing. I thank you for the healing that is manifesting. I thank you for the provision that is on his way. I thank you for the victory that is assured. I bless your name. I magnify your name. I exalt your name. You are faithful. [music] You are powerful. You are glorious. You are worthy of all praise in the name of Jesus. Before you go, I want to leave you with this word. The Bible says in Isaiah 41:10, "Fear thou not, for I am with thee. Be not dismayed, for I am thy God. I will strengthen thee, yay, I will help thee, yay, I will uphold thee with the right hand of my righteousness." God is with you. He has not left you. He has not forsaken you. He has not abandoned you. Whatever you are facing, you are not facing it alone. Whatever battle you are fighting, you are not fighting it by yourself. The Lord is on your side. The Lord is fighting for you. The Lord is working on your behalf. So go forth in confidence. Go forth in boldness. Go forth in the assurance that what God has started in your life, he will complete. The Bible says in Philippians 1:6, "Being confident of this very thing, that he which had begun a good work in you will perform it until the day of Jesus [music] Christ, God finishes what he starts." God completes what he begins. You are a work in progress and the master artist is not done with you yet. Walk into this day with your head held high. Walk with the confidence of a child of God. Walk with the authority that has been given to you. You are more than a conqueror through Christ Jesus. You are the righteousness of God in Christ. You are blessed and highly favored. You are anointed and appointed. You are called and chosen. You are loved and valued. You matter to God. Your life has purpose. Your existence has meaning. You are not an accident. You are not a mistake. You are a divine masterpiece created for such a time as this. In the mighty name of Jesus, I declare and decree that this day is blessed. This week is blessed. This month is blessed. This year is blessed. Your life is blessed. Everything you touch is blessed. Everywhere you go is blessed. You are a carrier of the glory of God. You are a vessel of honor. You are a channel of blessing. As you go, you carry the presence of God. As you move, you release the fragrance of Christ. As you speak, you release life. As you act, you manifest the kingdom. Go in peace. Go in power. Go in victory. The Lord bless you and keep you. The Lord make his face shine upon you and be gracious unto you. The Lord lift up his countenance upon you and give you peace in Jesus's mighty name. Amen. And amen.
